title: AI Chatbot Development
description: This project involved building an advanced AI automation system for Education & Migration Service (WEMS) to manage lead generation and student support on Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp 24/7. The system uses natural language processing, contextual awareness, and RAG technology to deliver accurate, human-like responses based strictly on verified client data. It captures student information during conversations, analyzes voice notes and images, and automatically syncs qualified leads to the CRM—creating a seamless, intelligent, and scalable solution that improves engagement and conversion rates.
fullDescription: This project involved the development of an advanced AI automation system for Education & Migration Service (WEMS), designed to handle lead generation and student support across Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp 24/7. The system delivers human-like conversational experiences using natural language processing and contextual awareness, allowing it to understand complex queries, correct user input, and respond accurately based on conversation history. It integrates voice note and image analysis to process documents and screenshots shared by students, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ensures that all responses are generated strictly from verified, client-provided data. The automation strategically captures student information such as names and phone numbers during conversations and instantly syncs qualified leads with the client’s CRM. To enhance user experience, the system includes human-behavior indicators like typing status and read receipts, resulting in a seamless, intelligent, and scalable automation solution that improves engagement, operational efficiency, and lead conversion.

title: AI Short Video Generator (Fully Automated with n8n)
description: Our Low-Cost AI Short Video Generator allows you to create complete 20–40 second videos using just three simple inputs: topic, setting, and visual style. Powered by n8n automation and advanced AI models, the system automatically generates visuals, script, voice narration, background audio, branding elements, and even uploads the final video—making professional short-form content creation faster, smarter, and more affordable than ever.
fullDescription: Our Low-Cost AI Short Video Generator is a fully automated content creation system built using n8n and advanced AI technologies. By simply providing three inputs—video topic, scene setting, and visual style—the system automatically generates a structured script, AI-powered voice narration, background visuals, text overlays, music, and brand elements such as logos or watermarks. The workflow intelligently combines all assets into a polished 20–40 second short video using automated rendering and transition effects. Designed for efficiency and scalability, this solution significantly reduces production costs while maintaining meaningful, engaging content output. It is ideal for businesses, agencies, and personal brands looking to produce consistent short-form videos without manual editing or high production expenses.

title: Ai Faceless Video Generator
description: This is a fully automated AI system built with n8n that transforms a simple topic into a cinematic scene prompt using strict JSON enforcement and structured validation. The workflow pulls data from Airtable, generates scenes using Google Gemini, enforces clean JSON formatting through an AI agent, validates and parses outputs using custom JavaScript, and maintains full retry and polling logic with proper error handling.
fullDescription: This is a fully automated AI system built with n8n that transforms a simple topic into a cinematic scene prompt using strict JSON enforcement and structured validation. The workflow pulls data from Airtable, generates scenes using Google Gemini, enforces clean JSON formatting through an AI agent, validates and parses outputs using custom JavaScript, and maintains full retry and polling logic with proper error handling.

title: Real Estate Research Report Automation System
description: I built an automated real estate research reporting system using Exa AI, n8n, and Presenton. Exa AI collects real-time market data, listings, and contextual insights from the web. The data is then structured inside n8n into sections like overview, pricing, listings, and key points before being sent to a pre-designed template in Presenton. The result is a clean, consistent, and fully automated research report with no manual formatting required—ideal for recurring client updates and market analysis.
fullDescription: This project is a fully automated real estate research report generation system designed to eliminate manual research, formatting, and slide design work. I use Exa AI to gather real-time market information, including pricing trends, listings, and contextual market insights from the web. The collected data flows into n8n, where it is organized into structured sections such as overview, pricing analysis, listings, and key insights. After structuring, the content is automatically sent to Presenton, where a pre-configured real estate research template ensures that all information is placed correctly into professionally designed slides. The final output is a clean, consistent, and presentation-ready report every time, making it highly efficient for recurring reports, investor updates, and client presentations while significantly reducing turnaround time.

title: Sales Report from Google Sheets
description: I built this automation to eliminate repetitive weekly sales reporting work. Sales data was already stored in Google Sheets, but generating executive updates required manually copying tables, writing summaries, and formatting slides every time. Using n8n, I automated the entire reporting workflow. The system now runs on schedule and generates weekly and monthly reports with minimal manual effort. The architecture is modular, allowing changes to data sources, prompts, or output formats without breaking the flow.
fullDescription:
This project was built to eliminate repetitive manual sales reporting tasks. Although sales data was consistently stored in Google Sheets, generating executive or sales update reports required repeating the same workflow every week — copying tables, writing summaries, and adjusting slide formatting manually.

To solve this, I designed a fully automated reporting system using n8n as the orchestration layer. The workflow pulls structured sales data directly from Google Sheets, processes it, formats summaries, and generates clean reports automatically.

One of the strongest aspects of this setup is its modular architecture. n8n handles orchestration only, which means the data source, prompts, or final output format can be modified independently without breaking the overall workflow.

The system now runs on a schedule, making weekly and monthly reporting nearly hands-off while maintaining consistency, scalability, and flexibility.

title: WhatsApp Business Automation
description: I built an AI-powered WhatsApp automation system that analyzes customer text, voice, and image messages and automatically responds with relevant product, service, or company information. The system integrates with a database, CRM/Google Sheets, and supports human handover when needed. It streamlines customer communication, lead collection, and support — all through an automated workflow powered by AI.
fullDescription:
I developed a complete AI-driven WhatsApp automation workflow designed to intelligently handle customer interactions across multiple message formats — including text, voice messages, and images.

The system automatically processes incoming messages, transcribes voice notes, analyzes images, and understands customer intent using AI models. Based on the request, it retrieves relevant product details, service information, or company data from a structured database and delivers accurate responses instantly.

Key Features:

Multi-format message handling (Text, Voice, Image)

Voice transcription and analysis

Image understanding and contextual response

Dynamic information retrieval from database

Automated lead capture into CRM / Google Sheets

Human agent handover system

Moderator notification when escalation is required

Fully automated text-based response system

If a customer requests to speak with a human agent, the system automatically forwards the customer’s number and details to the business owner or moderator for manual follow-up.

This automation significantly reduces response time, improves customer experience, automates lead management, and ensures no inquiry goes unanswered.

The system is built using AI agents, database integration, workflow automation, and WhatsApp API integration to create a scalable and intelligent customer communication solution.

title: n8n Community node Courier
description: I built an NPM package that simplifies courier integrations for n8n community Node.js projects in Bangladesh. It provides a clean, reusable interface for connecting with services like Steadfast and RedX, reducing repetitive setup work and making delivery workflows faster to implement.
fullDescription: Courier integrations can be messy and time-consuming—especially when working with multiple Bangladeshi delivery providers and inconsistent APIs. To solve this, I created an open-source NPM package that standardizes courier integration for InHertent/“Inheten” community Node.js applications. The package offers a simple, developer-friendly API to connect with couriers like Steadfast and RedX (with more providers planned), so developers can create shipments, manage delivery-related operations, and handle common edge cases without rewriting the same integration logic in every project. The goal is to make courier setup plug-and-play for Bangladeshi eCommerce and logistics projects, improving reliability, saving development time, and keeping integrations clean and maintainable.

title: Hand-tracking
description: I built an interactive hand-tracking visual experience that uses real-time camera input to detect and follow hand movement. The project features multiple generative visual effects that respond smoothly to gestures—moving as the hand moves and switching modes when a fist is detected—creating a playful, motion-controlled digital artwork.
fullDescription: This project is a real-time, camera-based hand-tracking experience designed to turn hand gestures into dynamic generative visuals. It requests webcam access, detects the user’s hand, and continuously maps hand position and motion to on-screen particle effects and attractor-style animations. As the user moves their hand, the visuals orbit, flow, and react in a responsive way, creating an immersive “touchless” interaction. The experience includes multiple visual modes/effects that can be cycled through using a simple gesture—closing the hand into a fist triggers a mode change—so users can explore different styles without any UI controls. Overall, it’s a creative coding project that combines computer vision, gesture-based interaction, and real-time graphics to produce an engaging, futuristic visual playground.
